v.1: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, Who walks in his ways.
v.2: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
v.3: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of your house; Your children like olive plants, Around your table.
v.4: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
v.5: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, And may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
v.6: Yes, may you see your children's children. Peace be upon Israel.
